# assignmentB2MahsaGhahremani

This R package provides a function to count missing values in a dataset by group. It helps users identify which columns have missing values and compare missing data across different groups.

## Installation

You can install this package from GitHub using:

```r
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github(
  "UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2MahsaGhahremani",
  ref = "0.1.0"
)
```

## Example

The package includes the function `count_all_missing_by_group()`. It counts missing values in each column for each group.

For example, we can use the built-in `airquality` dataset to count missing values by month.

```{r example}
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```

The output shows the number of missing values in each column for each month.
